stance_basis: paraphrased as citing ORV use as chief cause of massive destructive effects in the Mojave Desert and along the Colorado River
summary: The National Wildlife Federation, described as the nation's largest conservation organisation, is paraphrased as having cited ORV use as the chief cause of massive destructive effects in the Mojave Desert and along the Colorado River. This citation appears in the document window as a narrator paraphrase attributed to NORA, indicating the NWF's opposition to unregulated ORV use on public lands. No direct letter or statement from the NWF appears in this window.
summary_quote: Recently, the National Wildlife Federation—the nation's largest conservation organisation—cited ORV use as the chief cause of massive destructive effects in the Mojave Desert and along the Colorado River.
